award/01-as-a-child.jpg: Kathak was her first training ground, in a home full of music and learning. Here she is already in costume.
award/02-a-young-dancer.jpg: Another early portrait: young, serious and ready.
award/03-with-dr-radhakrishnan.jpg: With Dr. Radhakrishnan, then Vice President of India.
award/04-1972.jpg: 1972. Odissi, learned from Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra, is by now her own language.
award/06-early-performance-with-musician: An early performance, the musicians seated behind her. She has always worked closely with musicians.
award/07-1979.jpg: 1979, palms joined high above her head.
award/08-1981-in-profile.jpg: 1981, in profile, her hands close to her face.
award/09-with-pandit-durga-lal.jpg: In duet with Pandit Durga Lal, a Kathak master, the form she began with.
award/10-in-green-and-purple.jpg: Bowing low in green and purple.
award/11-in-white-and-red.jpg: Both hands at her ears, in white and red.
award/12-a-profile-in-red.jpg: In red, in profile, fingers already shaped for the next gesture.
kuchipudi/01-a-close-portrait.jpg: Hands open, eyes steady. The story has already begun.
kuchipudi/02-in-green-and-purple.jpg: Green silk, violet light, a pause between two steps.
kuchipudi/03-in-orange-on-stage.jpg: One hand lifted, the rest of the stage left dark so there is only her to watch.
kuchipudi/04-in-blue-and-silver.jpg: Her fingers point into the light and the whole frame follows them.
kuchipudi/05-mid-leap-in-blue.jpg: Mid-leap, the blue skirt still catching up with her.
kuchipudi/06-leaning-in-orange.jpg: A slow lean in orange, held a moment longer than you expect.
kuchipudi/07-arms-wide.jpg: Arms wide over a blue-lit floor.
kuchipudi/08-beside-the-lamp.jpg: Down on one knee beside the lamp and the garlanded deity. Kuchipudi grew out of devotion.
kuchipudi/09-in-red.jpg: The red skirt opens like a fan around her.
kuchipudi/10-red-arms-spread.jpg: Red light, red silk, arms flung wide.
mantra-bhasha/01-standing-in-red.jpg: Hands drawn in, weight settled: the quiet before the next movement.
mantra-bhasha/02-copper-and-red.jpg: Copper and red, one foot lifted, every line deliberate.
mantra-bhasha/03-a-close-portrait.jpg: Dark-lined eyes, fingers shaped into a mudra, and she is looking straight at you.
mantra-bhasha/04-two-dancers-in-step.jpg: Green beside blue, two dancers moving to the same beat.
santoor-rabab/01-at-the-santoor.jpg: Santoor on his lap, a half smile, in no hurry to begin.
santoor-rabab/02-with-the-rabab.jpg: Pandit Mukesh Sharma at home with the rabab, somewhere in the middle of a thought.
vocal/01-in-white-with-stoles.jpg: Brothers in white and printed stoles, one seated with a painted string instrument, the other standing close behind.
